elementDefinitions.attendanceSectionDescription: Optional link to a fine account and default amounts for absences.
elementDefinitions.autoEventRowsHint: Automatic event rows work with filters, not a fixed initial value.
elementDefinitions.autoSourceFieldHelp: Which value should be prefilled in this row?
elementDefinitions.basicsDescription: Name, subtitle and starting content of this block.
elementDefinitions.basicsDescriptionEdit: Maintain the block's name, subtitle and starting content. The block type can be changed above at any time.
elementDefinitions.blockHintCreateText: The block title appears later in the protocol. Fixed blocks should not be editable; multi-entry blocks such as todos or images can hold several entries.
elementDefinitions.blockHintEditText: Use the copy from the last session when text or todos should be prefilled automatically from an earlier protocol.
elementDefinitions.blockNameHelpCreate: Optional. If empty, the block appears directly under the element title.
elementDefinitions.blockNameHelpEdit: Leave empty if the block should not have its own subheading.
elementDefinitions.blocksSectionDescription: These blocks belong permanently to this element. You can reorder them directly here via drag & drop.
elementDefinitions.chartSectionDescription: Choose the statistics chart to show in this block.
elementDefinitions.chooseTypeHint: Choose the block type, then configure the matching settings.
elementDefinitions.contentHelp: For static text blocks this is the fixed content; for normal text blocks it is the starting value.
elementDefinitions.contentPlaceholder: Used as fixed content for static text, otherwise as starting content
elementDefinitions.copyFromLastHelp: When creating a new protocol, the content of the same block from the last protocol is prefilled instead of the starting content.
elementDefinitions.copyFromLastLabel: Copy data from the last session
elementDefinitions.createBlockDescription: Add a new block with clear settings to this element.
elementDefinitions.createElementDescription: Choose the block type and set a title and content for the new element.
elementDefinitions.createFooterNote: You can add more blocks after creating the element.
elementDefinitions.cycleTokensHelp: Usable in titles and content - replaced based on the template's cycle when the protocol is created.
elementDefinitions.deleteBlockConfirm: Delete this block permanently? This cannot be undone.
elementDefinitions.deleteElementConfirm: Delete this element permanently? This cannot be undone.
elementDefinitions.dueTagFilterLabel: Event tag filter for the due date
elementDefinitions.editBlockModalDescription: Edit the selected block directly in a tidy configuration view.
elementDefinitions.editModalDescription: Edit metadata and internal blocks in one tidy view.
elementDefinitions.editableInProtocolHelp: Off: the content stays fixed and is taken from the template.
elementDefinitions.elementEditorFallbackDescription: Elements bundle the internal blocks that templates and protocols are later built from.
elementDefinitions.elementSectionDescription: Shared heading for this element - blocks are attached below it.
elementDefinitions.elementTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Collaboration with the youth group
elementDefinitions.entryExitFirstUseLabel: On first use of this block
elementDefinitions.entryExitSectionDescription: Lists participant entries and exits that happened since this block was last used in an earlier protocol of this template.
elementDefinitions.eventListDescriptionCreate: Filters, visibility and table columns of the automatically displayed events.
elementDefinitions.eventListDescriptionEdit: Control filters, visibility and table columns of the automatically displayed events.
elementDefinitions.exportVisibleHelp: Empty blocks are automatically omitted from the export.
elementDefinitions.financeSectionDescription: Choose the finance account and, for transactions, the desired range.
elementDefinitions.finesListDescription: Shows the open fines from the attendance tracking.
elementDefinitions.finesListNote: No additional settings - the list comes from the attendance blocks and the fine account chosen there.
elementDefinitions.imageSectionDescription: Images are uploaded directly in the protocol.
elementDefinitions.imageSectionNote: No additional settings - the protocol shows an upload field with preview and lightbox.
elementDefinitions.listEntriesLoadFailed: List entries could not be loaded
elementDefinitions.matrixDesignerDescription: Add columns and rows directly as a matrix. Click a row or a cell to set data types and content.
elementDefinitions.matrixSectionDescriptionCreate: Create rows and columns in the designer. You can then set the data type per row and the event filter per column.
elementDefinitions.matrixSectionDescriptionEdit: Open the matrix designer to configure columns, rows and data types visually.
elementDefinitions.noMatrixYet: No matrix created yet. Open the designer and add columns and rows first.
elementDefinitions.noRowsYet: No rows created yet. Open the designer and add the first row.
elementDefinitions.onlyBeforeProtocolDateLabel: Only show events before the protocol date (review)
elementDefinitions.onlyCurrentCycleLabel: Only show events in the current cycle of this protocol
elementDefinitions.onlyFromProtocolDateLabel: Only show events from the protocol date
elementDefinitions.pageIntro1: Elements bundle several internal blocks such as text, todos, images or tables. Templates later only pick the finished element.
elementDefinitions.pageIntro2: Create fixed content here as non-editable blocks. It then appears read-only in the protocol automatically.
elementDefinitions.repeatDescriptionCreate: Decide whether this block appears once or repeats per event or todo.
elementDefinitions.repeatDescriptionEdit: The repetition sits directly on the block and can react to events or todos.
elementDefinitions.sessionDateDescription: Sets the next session date directly in the protocol.
elementDefinitions.sessionDateNote: No additional settings - the protocol shows a date field for the next session.
elementDefinitions.subtitleHelpCreate: Optional subtitle within the element in the protocol.
elementDefinitions.tableColumnsHelp: These columns appear in the event list - in the protocol and in the PDF export.
elementDefinitions.tableDesignerDescription: Manage the rows of this table. Click a row to set its alias, data type and content.
elementDefinitions.tableLinkedDescription: This table block is linked to a global list.
elementDefinitions.tableUnlinkedDescriptionCreate: Column headings, data source and the rows of this table.
elementDefinitions.tableUnlinkedDescriptionEdit: Define column headings, rows and data types for the table.
elementDefinitions.textFixedHelp: If the block is not editable, this text appears fixed in the protocol - otherwise it serves as a starting value that can be overwritten.
elementDefinitions.textSectionDescription: How the starting content carries over to the next protocol and how the block title appears in the PDF.
elementDefinitions.titleAsSubtitleHelp: Off: the block title is omitted from the export and the text sits directly under the element title.
elementDefinitions.titleAsSubtitleLabel: Render block title as a subtitle in the PDF
elementDefinitions.todoSettingsDescription: Additional rules for todo blocks, for example how the due date is assigned.
elementDefinitions.typePickerDescription: The type determines what is edited in the protocol. It can be changed again at any time.
